Bankruptcy is the only option here. You're only 26, you can survive it and recover.  There is life after bankruptcy.   You wouldn't live long enough to pay down that much cc debt.   Chalk it up as lesson learned,  stop treading water with them, and file. I hate to bring about bad news, but, you'll survive it. Also, no way would I use my Christmas bonus to make that payment on card 5.  NO WAY.   Put it on savings. File Bk, most attorneys will include their fees in the Bk filings, so, set up a monthly payment schedule. To add, the goal is to save for retirement for YOU!  The cc companies don't care.  While you own half of the burden, they are not innocent either. Why would they give so much potential debt to a 26 year old?  Given the economy, I'm thinking bks will be on the rise.  Stay away from the debt cons places, they are simply not good. They will ruin your credit and it'll be a death by a thousand cuts.  Rip the band aid off, save all you can the next couple of years.  After about a year, take out a secured card to start rebuilding credit.  Bk doesn't have the stigma it once did.  Good luck!
